name: Housou Kinshi ~ Joshi Ana Ryoujoku Nama Chuukei
original_name: 放送禁肢 ～女子アナ凌辱生中継
source:
Shigeru is a television producer. One day, the boss of a rival television company visits him for headhunting. For better pay, he needs to finish the TV news program that he is now in charge.... "How can I finish it...? Yes, how about broadcasting sex scenes of beautiful female newscasters...?" He now starts his secret plan....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090109030817/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007706]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
茂是一名电视节目制作人。一天，竞争电视台的老板前来挖角。为了获得更优厚的待遇，他必须让自己目前负责的电视新闻节目完结…"该怎么结束它…？对了，直播美丽女主播们的性爱场面如何…？"于是，他开始实施自己的秘密计划…
